p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-89e88452.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete the shorter of matching horizontal bars with color 1."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows_by_start = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cells = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not cells:
            continue
        # Only use a row whose non-background cells form one solid bar.
        a, b = min(cells), max(cells)
        if len(cells) != b - a + 1:
            continue
        color = grid[r][a]
        if any(grid[r][c] != color for c in range(a, b + 1)):
            continue
        rows_by_start.setdefault(a, []).append((r, b, color))
    candidates = []
    for start, bars in rows_by_start.items():
        full = [bar for bar in bars if bar[1] == w - 1]
        partial = [bar for bar in bars if bar[1] < w - 1]
        if full and partial:
            longest = max(full, key=lambda bar: bar[1])
            for bar in partial:
                if bar[2] == longest[2]:
                    candidates.append((bar[1] - start, bar, longest))
    if candidates:
        _, (r, end, color), _ = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
        for c in range(end + 1, w):
            out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
